name: PinnedSteps
description: A pinned two-column walkthrough inside its own smooth-scroll viewport: scrolling advances through the steps, highlighting and expanding the active step with a live progress line while the visual on the right crossfades to that step's illustration.
a11yNotes: The viewport is a focusable role="region" labelled by the title, so keyboard users can Tab to it and scroll with arrow/Page keys/Space (native, unsmoothed) with a 2px :focus-visible outline. Steps are an ordered list of buttons; the active one has aria-current="step" and activating any step scrolls the viewport to it. The "Step n of N" kicker is real text. Wheel input is smoothed only while the viewport can still move; at the edges wheel events are released to the page, and touch and scrollbar dragging stay native. The right-hand illustration, progress bars and dots are decorative and aria-hidden. Under prefers-reduced-motion the wheel is not intercepted, step clicks jump instantly and visuals switch without sliding, zooming or fading.

propsApi.name: steps
propsApi.default: ['Connect your sources', 'Map the signals', 'Watch it trend', 'Ship the insight']
propsApi.description: Step titles; each gets an equal share of the scroll distance and its own illustration.

propsApi.name: title
propsApi.description: Heading above the step list; also used as the scroll region's aria-label.

propsApi.name: accentColor
propsApi.description: Accent color for the active step badge, progress lines and illustrations.

propsApi.name: transition
propsApi.description: How the right-hand visual changes between steps.

propsApi.name: transitionDuration
propsApi.description: Duration in ms of the visual crossfade.

propsApi.name: showProgress
propsApi.description: Show the progress line inside the active step and the overall progress bar on the visual.

propsApi.name: height
propsApi.description: Height of the component's own scroll viewport in px (width is always 100%).

propsApi.name: borderRadius
propsApi.description: Corner radius of the viewport in px.

propsApi.name: lerp
propsApi.description: Interpolation factor per 60fps frame for wheel smoothing (0.05 floaty, 0.3 snappy).

propsApi.name: wheelMultiplier
propsApi.description: Multiplier applied to wheel and trackpad deltas.

propsApi.name: smooth
propsApi.description: Enable smooth wheel scrolling; false (or prefers-reduced-motion) uses native scrolling.

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root element.

propsApi.name: style
propsApi.description: Inline styles merged onto the root element.
